2014_spells.create-bonfire.description: You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the magic bonfire fills a 5-foot cube. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage. A creature must also make the saving throw when it moves into the bonfire's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
2014_spells.create-bonfire.effectSummary: Deal 1d8 fire damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.create-bonfire.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, you create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. A creature must also make the saving throw when it moves into the bonfire's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there; Until the spell ends, the magic bonfire fills a 5-foot cube; The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8). Until the spell ends, the magic bonfire fills a 5-foot cube; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
